ceu: ✦ The conjunction between Venus and Mars

t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Tidy your desk before you start.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Write something lovely about someone you care for.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on relationships and partnerships. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on routine, daily work and health. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on home and family. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on your money and what you value. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on your image and your personal energy. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on rest and your inner life. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on friends and plans for the future. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
Venus and Mars are together in {S:8}: affection and harmony, courage and initiative, all focused on your career and your goals. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.
